name: Google Cloud Speech-to-Text
tagline: Production speech recognition with streaming and many languages
description: Google Cloud Speech-to-Text converts audio to text using machine learning models. It supports batch and streaming recognition, many languages and dialects, speaker diarization, word-level timestamps, and automatic punctuation. Developers call the Cloud Speech-to-Text API over HTTPS (and gRPC) under speech.googleapis.com with Google Cloud authentication.

auth.details: Google Cloud OAuth2 access token or service account credentials (Bearer token). API keys are also supported for some REST methods when restricted. Enable Speech-to-Text API in a GCP project.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Speech-to-Text V1: 60 audio minutes per month per account at $0 for Standard models, with or without data logging. V2 has no recurring free allotment in the current pricing table; new customers may separately qualify for Google Cloud trial credits.

rate_limits: V1 defaults per developer project: 900 recognition requests per 60 seconds, 10 adaptation-resource requests per 60 seconds, and 480 audio-processing hours per day. Most quotas can be adjusted through Google Cloud.
use_cases: transcribe a short audio file to text
stream microphone audio for live captions
detect spoken language in an audio clip
diarize speakers in a meeting recording
